description: Trajectory disturbance curriculum bound to the unique OpenFOAM hydrodynamic baseline. Stochastic pool effects and added-mass uncertainty remain a separate residual-uncertainty curriculum.

metadata.additional_hydrodynamics_activation: scale=0 through policy step 22499; 0.35 from step 22500; 0.70 from step 40500; 1.00 from step 57000
metadata.added_mass_distribution: The recipe never replaces nominal added mass. It multiplies hydrodynamics.added_mass from the selected base profile by independent per-DOF, mean-one lognormal scales generated from standard-normal latent variables; the same sampled matrix is used by inertia and Coriolis terms.
metadata.actuator_timing_reference: Provisional external hardware reference pending synchronized PWM-to-force tests on the T60: tau=0.08 s for a Blue Robotics T200 and fixed command delay=0.13 s for a Blue Robotics Basic ESC. At the fixed 100 Hz physics rate, 0.13 s is 13 steps.
metadata.continuous_parameter_distribution: Bounded Gaussian: range midpoint is the mean and range endpoints are +/-3 standard deviations; stage amplitudes are symmetric +/-3-sigma bounds.
metadata.correlation_model: Independent reset-time sampling except for shared damping scale and staged disturbance magnitudes.

name: auv-pool-openfoam-hydrodynamics-dr-v1

parameter_sources.additional_hydrodynamics_scale_by_stage: Curriculum schedule for modeled, unmeasured pool-only effects; first non-zero scale begins at PPO iteration 88.
parameter_sources.added_mass_log_std_by_stage: Conservative engineering prior in log space; replace with covariance from AUV acceleration/free-decay identification.
parameter_sources.damping_scale_by_stage: Engineering curriculum; not yet derived from repeated target-pool identification.
parameter_sources.disturbance_curriculum_stage_steps: Trajectory curriculum schedule expressed in policy steps; use the selected MLP training configuration to derive iteration counts.
parameter_sources.mass_range: AUV CAD nominal only; no payload ensemble yet.
parameter_sources.thruster_scale_by_stage: Engineering curriculum; target T60 unit-to-unit measurements pending.
parameter_sources.thruster_tau_scale_by_stage: Engineering uncertainty around the external T200 nominal tau=0.08 s from Rossol et al., OCEANS 2022 (https://www.dfki.de/fileadmin/user_upload/import/12795_oceans2022_sos_paper_final.pdf); replace with T60 step-response measurements.
parameter_sources.thruster_command_delay_steps_range: Fixed 13 physics steps = 0.13 s at 100 Hz, from the NUS Bumblebee oscilloscope measurement of a Blue Robotics Basic ESC (https://bumblebee.sg/pdf/Bumblebee_Robosub_Paper_2022.pdf); no delay randomization until T60 controller-to-thrust timing is measured.
parameter_sources.volume_range: Fixed from the pool measurement that buoyancy exceeds weight by a 0.24 kg-equivalent: V=(11.301+0.24)/1000=0.011541 m^3 at rho=1000 kg/m^3; no displacement randomization until repeat measurements provide an uncertainty range.
parameter_sources.water_current_max_by_stage: Existing pool-training curriculum; target-pool repeated measurements pending.
parameter_sources.water_current_tau_range: Engineering prior for slowly varying pool flow; target-pool time-series fit pending.
parameter_sources.water_current_variation_std_by_stage: Engineering curriculum; target-pool time-series fit pending.
parameter_sources.water_current_vertical_max_by_stage: Engineering curriculum; target-pool repeated measurements pending.
